gui.chess.clear_hint: Click Clear to start a new game
gui.chess.exit_confirm: Press Esc again to leave the board; the game will be preserved
gui.chess.xq.black_in_check: Black is in check and must respond!
gui.chess.xq.empty_position: There is no piece at the starting position
gui.chess.xq.game_full: This game already has two players
gui.chess.xq.host_only: Only the host can set the piece colors
gui.chess.xq.not_host: Only the host can operate this board
gui.chess.xq.not_player: You are not a player in this game
gui.chess.xq.own_piece: The destination contains your own piece
gui.chess.xq.red_in_check: Red is in check and must respond!
gui.chess.xq.rule.advisor: The advisor moves one square diagonally inside the palace
gui.chess.xq.rule.cannon: The cannon moves orthogonally; it needs no screen to move and exactly one screen to capture
gui.chess.xq.rule.elephant: The elephant moves two squares diagonally, cannot cross the river, and its eye must be clear
gui.chess.xq.rule.general: The general moves one square orthogonally inside the palace, or flies along an open file
gui.chess.xq.rule.horse: The horse moves in an L shape and its leg must be clear
gui.chess.xq.rule.rook: The rook moves orthogonally with no pieces in its path
gui.chess.xq.rule.soldier: The soldier moves forward; after crossing the river it may also move sideways, never backward
gui.chess.xq.self_check: Your general would still be in check; you must respond to the check
